definition: Using the Information to train, fine-tune, pre-train or otherwise develop an artificial-intelligence or machine-learning model, including any generative AI system, large language model or foundation model, that will be accessible to any third party.

prefLabel: Bulk replication or recreation of viewed Information
definition: Using technical measures to download, replicate or recreate any substantial part of the Information made available to view. Up to 20 images per calendar month extracted from the data (e.g. screen grabs) is considered insubstantial.

prefLabel: Distribution of a model developed with the Information
definition: Sharing, selling, distributing or making available any model developed with the Information using AI or ML techniques.

prefLabel: Submission to a third-party hosted AI service
definition: Making the Information available to a third party by submitting it to a hosted AI service in circumstances where that third party is permitted to retain it for, or use it in, training or developing its models.
